activity_summary: At nine you were in the king. Kemp said you, and did not start a quarrel about it. The sheets in your sleeve stayed in your sleeve. The afternoon was the king, and you were in him.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stayed in the king, and kept the sheets back.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Separated the hour from the dinner.

entities.name: Richard III
entities.context: Mentioned in The king at nine

facets.activity: Rehearsed the king and kept the sheets sleeved

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: You. I have said you before
